description: Grouped personal Codex skills for agent workflows: kb-for-agents for three-layer knowledge management and core-dev for portable development cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Grouped skills for KB management and core dev cleanup
interface.longDescription: Umbrella package for grouped agent skills. The kb-for-agents group builds, queries, refreshes, records decisions, and maintains a three-layer knowledge base inside a codebase or notes corpus. The core-dev group includes simplify-code for behavior-preserving cleanup of changed code.
defaultPrompt: Build a KB for this codebase.
Simplify the current diff without changing behavior.
